meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、查找、修复并美化项目里的界面组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常用代码搭建界面,想快速管理UI组件
copy.tagline_en: Add, find, fix, and style UI components in your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build interfaces with code and want an easier way to manage UI components.

howto.what: 装上后,当你处理 shadcn/ui 项目时,Claude 会先读取项目配置和已装组件,再通过命令行帮你添加、查找、更新界面组件;它还会按 shadcn 的书写规则检查并修正代码,并提供相关文档和示例。
howto.when: 当项目里有 components.json 文件,或你提到“shadcn init”、“--preset”等与预设、组件注册表相关的指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 shadcn 的 Button 组件
say.note: Claude 会先检查已装组件,再运行 CLI 添加。

say.text: 搜索一下社区注册表里有没有轮播图组件
say.note: 它会运行 search 命令查询注册表。

say.text: 给这个项目切换到某个预设,换成另一套样式
say.note: 它会先询问采用覆盖、合并还是跳过。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to manage shadcn/ui projects: it reads project config and installed components, uses the CLI to add/search/update components, validates and fixes code against shadcn rules, and provides docs and examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work on a shadcn/ui project with a components.json file, or when you mention 'shadcn init', presets, '--preset' codes, or component registries.

say_en.text: Add a shadcn Button component to my project.
say_en.note: Claude checks installed components, then runs add via CLI.

say_en.text: Search for a carousel component in community registries.
Switch this project to a preset to change its style.
say_en.note: Claude asks how to apply: overwrite, merge, or skip.
